def transform(grid):
    from collections import Counter
    R=len(grid); C=len(grid[0])
    cnt=Counter(grid[r][c] for r in range(R) for c in range(C) if grid[r][c]!=0)
    if not cnt: return [row[:] for row in grid]
    col=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    rows=[r for r in range(R) if any(grid[r][c]!=0 for c in range(C))]
    top=min(rows); bot=max(rows)
    out=[[0]*C for _ in range(R)]
    for r in range(R):
        for c in range(C):
            if grid[r][c]!=0:
                out[r][c]=col
                out[top+bot-r][c]=col
    return out
